US Teen Charged in Alleged Mall Shooting Plot

A teenager in the United States has been charged in connection with an alleged plot to carry out a shooting at a mall, reportedly inspired by the Daesh (ISIS) group. The specific location of the mall was not detailed in the coverage. In a separate but similar incident, a 13-year-old student in Guelph, Canada, was charged after making online threats against a high school.
